WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.amount,
    t.balance,
    t.type,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
per_account AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    region,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) as avg_amount,
    AVG(balance) as avg_balance
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
per_region AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance
  FROM per_account
  GROUP BY region
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_avg_amount
  FROM per_region
)
SELECT 
  pr.region,
  pr.region_avg_amount,
  pr.region_avg_balance,
  CASE 
    WHEN gs.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
    THEN pr.region_avg_amount / gs.global_avg_amount
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM per_region pr
CROSS JOIN global_stats gs;

assumptions.assumption: For each account, compute the average balance across *all* transactions (including types other than PRIJEM/VYDAJ), while the average amount uses only PRIJEM/VYDAJ transactions.
When the global mean of region amount-averages is NULL or missing, return NULL for the ratio field rather than omitting the region row entirely.
